the_ashen_crucible.title: The Ashen Crucible
the_ashen_crucible.subtitle: Single-Use Martial Armory
the_ashen_crucible.description: Run by Murn Ember-Spite (Duergar). Built inside a giant forge ash-catcher. Specializes in single-use martial gear and forge coatings.

inventory.description: Sharpening a bladed or piercing weapon for 1 min coats the edge in molten grit. Weapon deals +1d4 fire damage on hits for 1 hour.
Hammered into armor during a short rest. Reaction when hit by a melee attack: Detonate a rivet to blind the attacker until end of their next turn (DC 12 Con save).
Coat a weapon or 3 arrows as an action. Next hit against metal/stone armor or construct deals 2d4 acid damage and reduces target AC by 1 for the encounter.
Applied to leather armor or shield in 1 min. Hardens into an iron shell granting +1 AC for 1 hour (shatters upon taking bludgeoning or critical damage).
Single-use ammunition capped with black powder. Deals weapon damage + 1d6 fire damage to target and 1 fire damage to all creatures within 5 ft.

the_single_stanza.title: The Single Stanza
the_single_stanza.subtitle: Arcane Consumables & Wards
the_single_stanza.description: Run by Nixie 'Ink-Fingers' Flit (Sprite). Built inside the hollowed spine of a giant tome. Specializes in single-use spell catalysts.

inventory.description: Paint a rune on your forehead while casting a Ritual spell as an action to cast it instantly (1 action) instead of adding 10 minutes.
Crush as a somatic component when casting an elemental spell (acid/cold/fire/lightning/thunder) to ignore target damage resistance for that cast.
Wearable patch. Reaction when targeted by an attack or spell: Triggers Shield or Absorb Elements at 1st level without expending a spell slot.
Bonus Action: Inhale a pinch to regain one 1st-level spell slot. You take 1d4 force damage and cannot cast non-cantrip spells until end of next turn.
Bonus Action: Light before casting a spell. Illuminates 15 ft radius for 1 round; spell deals +1d4 radiant damage and gains advantage on attack roll (+1 to DC).
Bonus Action snack: Allows you to cast a known cantrip as a Bonus Action this turn. Natural 1 or target natural 20 triggers a harmless wild magic surge.

the_copper_alembic.title: The Copper Alembic
the_copper_alembic.subtitle: Apothecary & Diluted Elixirs
the_copper_alembic.description: Run by Gideon Vane (Halfling) & Brawn (Hill Giant). Suspended 40ft in the rafters in a giant copper still. Micro-diluted giant potions.

inventory.description: Thick, savory brew. Drinking grants 1d6 + 2 temporary hit points and advantage on saving throws against poison and fright for 1 hour.
Bonus Action drink: Grants Feather Fall for 1 minute and triples your jump distance for the duration.
Micro-diluted Hill Giant potion. For 1 minute, count as one size larger for carrying/pushing/lifting and gain +2 to Strength melee damage rolls.
Bonus Action drink: Next weapon attack or cantrip hit within 1 minute deals +1d6 lightning damage and prevents target from taking reactions until their next turn.
Apply 2 drops to eyes: Grants 60 ft darkvision for 1 hour (or allows seeing clearly through light fog, snow, and smoke if you already have darkvision).
Action drink: Instantly neutralizes one poison or cures one disease affecting you, and restores 1d4 hit points.

the_clockwork_alcove.title: The Clockwork Alcove
the_clockwork_alcove.subtitle: Salvage & Clockwork Gadgets
the_clockwork_alcove.description: Run by Keeva Copperpin (Rock Gnome). Located inside a giant wall-clock pendulum. Specializes in single-use mechanical tools.

inventory.description: Action: Throw up to 30 ft. Rattles, sparks, and makes loud noise for 1 round. Nearby enemies take disadv. on Perception; first attack against distracted target has adv.
Bonus Action: Attach to weapon/ammo. Next hit deals +1d8 lightning damage and target must pass a DC 12 Con save or be incapacitated until start of next turn.
Action: Wind and release. Flies 30 ft/round for 1 minute while you view through a monocular lens (with 30 ft darkvision). Breaks after use.
Fires a piton & wire tether up to 40 ft into stone/wood/dirt. Automatically reels up to 300 lbs directly to the point of impact.
Action: Smear on metal lock/hinge to ignite with intense heat. Fuses metal shut (DC 20 Strength to break) or melts through locks up to 1 inch thick.
Affix to armor/shield (1 min). Reaction when targeted by prone or forced movement effects: Automatically pass the save/check to stay rooted.

the_sunken_hearth.title: The Sunken Hearth
the_sunken_hearth.subtitle: Tavern, Food & Lodging
the_sunken_hearth.description: Run by Barney Chubb (Halfling) & Lady Thrum (Cloud Giant Matriarch). Built into the Great Refectory fireplace.

inventory.description: Hammock in warm chimney drafts. Full night rest grants +5 ft movement speed during your next adventuring day.
Plush alcove beds in match-flint storage room. Start your next adventuring day with 5 temporary hit points.
Hearty meal served with hearth bread. Grants advantage on Con saves against extreme cold and environmental hazards next adventuring day.
1-hour geothermal tub soak removes 1 level of exhaustion and grants a +1 bonus to Strength saves during your next adventuring day.
A shimmering lavender tea. Completing a long rest after drinking regains 1 additional spent Hit Die.
